observations: Multiple white multifunction printers wrapped in clear plastic.
The brand 'RICOH' is visible on the front panel in photo 0 and photo 1.
The model 'MP C4504' is visible on the top left of the unit in photo 0.
The unit has a large paper output tray and a document feeder.
A sticker on the front in photos 0 and 1 advertises 'Fancy' and 'Decoration' services.
The unit is stored in a warehouse or shop environment with other similar units.
A paper list with serial numbers is visible on top in photo 2.

claims.claim: Low page count, under 20,000 copies. New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The printer may not power on or have a faulty print head.
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on and successfully printing a test page.

risks.risk: The toner cartridges may be empty or missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner cartridges installed in the unit.

risks.risk: The internal paper tray may be jammed or the scanner glass may be dirty.
risks.proof: A photo of the paper tray with a sheet of paper inside and a clear view of the scanner glass.
risks.if_unproven: as having a jammed tray and dirty scanner

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the toner cartridges installed.
Photo of the paper tray with a sheet of paper inside.
Photo of the serial number sticker on the back of the unit.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
